item.title: Pasta/80 is a simple Pascal cross compiler targeting the Z80 microprocessor
item.description:
📝 PASTA/80 PASTA/80 is a simple Pascal cross compiler targeting the Z80 microprocessor. Supported language elements The supported Pascal dialect is an almost exact clone of the original Turbo Pascal 3. Building and setting up the compiler The compiler is itself written in Pascal.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/pleumann/pasta80
